_notes: D is the default cap and, when D >= max_degree, switches fit to no-cap reference mode (per-kind caps ignored, every capped measurement uses D). degree_hist is uncapped (max_degree = public Dmax, coarse grid hist). Caps, bins, max_degree, min_degree, hist grid and shares were chosen by looking at non-private statistics of the real graph (ledger caveat). homophily_groups null = use homophily_attrs as the single group (one attr_edge_pair named exactly 'attr_edge_pair', today's behaviour). Enabling more than the primary group is the decision point of docs/snap/attribute-coupling-plan.md section 11 (budget policy: the attr_edge_pair share is split equally among the instances, so each extra group makes all of them noisier); when taken, set "homophily_groups": [["school"], ["hometown"], ["location"]] (candidate ranking: inside/reports/attributes.md).
